name: Continuum Staff
text:
A looped band of copper, winding in on itself, sits atop the head of this shiny metal staff. The staff's surface seems to warp unpredictably when viewed, the reflections across the shiny surface of its length never forming the same pattern twice.

---
Activate—Restitch Time r (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would fail or critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

Effect You briefly reverse time to fix your error. Reroll the triggering check, taking the better of the two results.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
- Cantrip Warp Step

- 1st Déjà Vu, Synchronize

- 2nd Unrelenting Gravity

- 3rd Haste, Inertia Lock, Time Jump

- 4th Flicker, Translocate, Unrelenting Gravity

- 5th Rewinding Step, Space Fold Gate, Translocate

- 6th Cast into Time, Collective Transposition

- 7th Infinitesimal Collapse Field, Space Fold Gate

---
Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
